div.head: Cn 1020 2
div.ab: ⁊ ic cyðe eow, þæt ic wylle beon hold hlaford ⁊ unswicende to Godes gerihtum ⁊ to rihtre woroldlage.
⁊ ic cyðe eow þæt ic wylle beon hold hlaford ⁊ unswicende to Godes gerihtum ⁊ to rihtre woroldlage.
And ic cyðe eow þæt ic wylle beon hold hlaford and unswicende to Godes gerihtum and to rihtre woroldlage.
Und ich künde euch, dass ich ein gnädiger Herr sein werde und unwandelbar treu den Gerechtsamen der Kirche und rechter Satzung des Staates.
And I make known to you that I will be a gracious lord and unfailing in [upholding] God's rights and just secular law.
And I declare to you that I will be a gracious lord, and will not fail to support the rights of the church and just secular law.
And I inform you that I will be a gracious lord and a faithful observer of God’s rights and just secular law.
And I proclaim to you that I will be a gracious lord, devoted to the rights of the church and to just secular law.
